_about: VOICE-AGENT-242. Ten questions played in order as ONE conversation, so the follow-ups have something to follow. Taken from logs/client-*.log (user_transcript), except q10, written after the remark of VOICE-AGENT-211. Each clip is audio/<id>.wav, recorded by Philippe as he would say it to the app. `expect` drives the automatic checks of report.py (search_must_mention_any: every query_text2sql call of the turn must contain one of these words, which catches a bare follow-up, a pronoun sent as is, or a question translated before the search); the rest is judged by ear and by reading the transcripts.
